scope: IAM WR18/19 tested product plus current related documents and selected text evidence; local main commit plus explicitly authorized non-force origin/main push
dependencies: WR17/18/19 accepted evidence and unchanged main/product baseline
acceptance: staged product exactly matches tested source and deletions; no unrelated paths or credentials; local main commit and post-commit verification; remote main SHA equals committed main
tests: source SHA/mode match, generated artifacts match, diff/secret/path checks; reuse exact-byte remote test evidence; no new builds for unchanged code
recovery: pre-commit backup of affected files; do not reset/stash/clean original worktrees; leave unrelated untracked evidence intact; any future revert must be explicit
stop: main/index/source drift, unexpected path overlap, sensitive data, commit hook failure
remote_push: User explicitly added: 还要推送到远端; authorize normal non-force origin main push after staged verification and commit
